# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(lme4); library(lmerTest); library(geepack); library(sandwich); library(lmtest); library(performance); library(clubSandwich) })
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
bp_path <- c("data/bp_trial.csv", "../data/bp_trial.csv", "../../data/bp_trial.csv")
bp_path <- bp_path[file.exists(bp_path)][1]
bp <- read_csv(bp_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = c("Control", "Programme")), sex = factor(sex), village = factor(village), person = factor(person))
bp12 <- bp |> filter(months == 12)                       # the 12-month visit: one row per person
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

chunks.code:
m_lm <- lm(sbp ~ arm + age + sex + bmi, data = bp12)
rbind(naive = summary(m_lm)$coefficients["armProgramme", 1:2],
      cluster_robust = coeftest(m_lm, vcov = vcovCL(m_lm, cluster = bp12$village))["armProgramme", 1:2]) |> round(3)

d12 <- bp12 |> arrange(village)
g1 <- geeglm(sbp ~ arm + age + sex + bmi, id = village, data = d12, family = gaussian, corstr = "exchangeable")
round(summary(g1)$coefficients["armProgramme", ], 3)
summary(g1)$corr

g_ind <- geeglm(sbp ~ arm + age + sex + bmi, id = village, data = d12, family = gaussian, corstr = "independence")
c(independence = coef(g_ind)[["armProgramme"]], exchangeable = coef(g1)[["armProgramme"]]) |> round(2)

g2 <- geeglm(controlled ~ arm + age + sex + bmi, id = village, data = d12, family = binomial, corstr = "exchangeable")
round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(g2), confint.default(g2)))["armProgramme", ], 2)
